Mission Local reported that MEDA was in contract to buy the four-story building at 2901 16th St., two blocks from the 16th Street BART station, and planned to rehabilitate it as permanent affordable housing. The story described 62 planned homes—two single-room occupancy units, 54 studios and six one-bedroom units—and said current tenants could remain or move out during rehabilitation. The purchase depended on city approval of a loan through the Small Sites Program.
